name: Chin Hsin Environ Engineering Co. Ltd.
summary: Chin Hsin Environ Engineering Co., Ltd. provides general, hazardous industrial, and biomedical waste removal and treatment services in Taiwan. The company offers sludge, organic solvent, and waste chemical removal products for business waste applications; and red infection bags and containers for medical waste. It also provides flowerpots, outdoor lounge chairs, beer tables, combined platforms, and benches. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Yúnlín, Taiwan. Chin Hsin Environ Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Sunny Friend Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
